rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday Cantonese noun for a brief or cursory look.

example.english: I could see a cat under the table at a glance.
example.traditional: 我一眼就睇到張枱底有隻貓。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 tai2 dou2 zoeng1 toi2 dai2 jau5 zek3 maau1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for briefly looking at something.

example.english: Let me glance at it first.

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the quick act of directing your eyes toward something rather than inspecting it.

example.english: I heard a sound at the door, so I gave the doorway one quick glance and went back into the room.
example.traditional: 聽到門口有聲，我望一眼就返入房。
example.jyutping: teng1 dou2 mun4 hau2 jau5 seng1 ngo5 mong6 jat1 ngaan5 zau6 faan1 jap6 fong2
